description: Business objectives and stakeholders are identified and documented
Risk tolerance and appetite are defined
Cybersecurity roles and responsibilities are assigned
An information security policy exists and is communicated
Cybersecurity risk is reviewed by leadership on a regular basis
Third-party vendors and software supply chain risks are assessed
Legal and regulatory requirements are identified and tracked
Physical devices and systems on the network are inventoried
Software and applications installed are inventoried
Operating system versions and build numbers are identified
Known vulnerabilities on identified assets are cataloged
Patch/update status is assessed against vendor release cadence
Critical business functions dependent on IT systems are documented
Data classification (what's sensitive vs not) is defined
User accounts follow least-privilege principles
Multi-factor authentication is enabled on admin/critical accounts
Sensitive data at rest is encrypted
Data in transit is encrypted (HTTPS/TLS enforced)
Host-based firewall is enabled on all endpoints
Operating systems are patched within a defined SLA (e.g. 30 days)
Antivirus/endpoint protection is installed and active
Remote maintenance access is logged and controlled
Staff receive periodic security awareness training
Network segmentation separates critical systems from general traffic
Regular backups are performed and tested for restoration
Physical access to servers/network equipment is restricted
Unusual login attempts or access patterns are monitored
Network traffic is monitored for known malicious indicators
New/unauthorized devices joining the network are flagged
Security-relevant events are logged centrally
Systems are periodically scanned for missing patches
Detection processes are tested periodically
Firewall rules are reviewed for overly permissive configurations
An incident response plan exists
Roles for internal/external incident communication are defined
Incidents are investigated and root cause is documented
Compromised systems can be isolated quickly
Lessons learned from incidents update future response plans
Regulatory breach notification requirements are known and actionable
A disaster recovery plan exists and is documented
Recovery plans are updated based on lessons learned
Recovery activities are communicated to stakeholders
